env.scratch: SCR = the migrate run's scratch dir; D = docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p3-backup
env.userDataA: $SCR/backup/udA = the data folders of the migrate run's userData after its part B (log 24) + inference.json {kind: llamacpp, baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:8859/v1, model: none, apiKeyEnv: null, sidecar: null}
env.appA: AETHER_TEST_BACKUP_PATH=$SCR/backup/files/io.spire-backup OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/backup/udA bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9352   (both backup dialogs answer with that path; export writes it, import reads it)
env.userDataB: $SCR/backup/udB: empty + the same inference.json (another device: its own identity/device.key)
env.userDataC: $SCR/backup/udC: empty + the same inference.json (part D, after the ensure.ts change)
env.build: main 51817a3 plus the uncommitted working tree of every session, with this session's planner fix; parts A–C before and part D after the ensure.ts change

sequence: shell: prepare udA; launch app A
run.json (part A): export B1 from Worlds → Saves; cp io.spire-backup b1.spire-backup; Resume, leave note Y, export B2; cp io.spire-backup b2.spire-backup

shell: close A; wipe: rm -rf udA/instances/23qc-6pqs-mucdvy80 udA/histories/hivribsqepe5ifl3nxixjesz3mxdw3wnataqtttfeldkeagqfwtoa udA/histories/index.json; cp b1.spire-backup io.spire-backup; relaunch A

run-b-wipe-restore-diverge.json (part B): Restore backup (B1); shell: compare the restored files with B1; Resume, leave note X; shell: cp b2.spire-backup io.spire-backup; Restore backup (B2) onto the diverged history
shell: close A; cp b2.spire-backup io.spire-backup; launch app B on udB
run-c-other-device.json (part C): Restore backup (B2), Resume: adoption; a note; an unwritten chunk
shell: close B; apply the ensure.ts change; cp b1.spire-backup io.spire-backup; launch on udC
run-d-after-ensure-fix.json (part D): Restore backup (B1), Resume: adoption again; then relaunch A (udA, no backup path) and call world.ensure on both of A's saves: no adoption

actions.note: shell: cp io.spire-backup b1.spire-backup. A2: note Y, then export B2

actions.eval: (() => { const f = document.querySelector("input"); f.focus(); return document.activeElement === f })()

actions.type: Note Y: written after backup one, before backup two.
